US mega-cap tech (MSTR, NINE) faces regulatory and valuation headwinds, prompting capital rotation into ASEAN and Korean value tech names with stronger earnings visibility.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian tech names with local revenue exposure, led by MLPT and INET, as the ID outperformance (+1.48%) reflects domestic liquidity and digital adoption momentum. US tech drag is temporary; rotate into beaten-down Korean semis (005930, 000660) for a rebound. Trim MSTR on volatility.

US monetary policy easing and a stable IDR are improving liquidity conditions for Indonesian financials, benefiting leveraged growth names more than defensive banks.

Favor MBMA and AMMN for copper-gold upside, but trim SGER and COAL into rallies given valuation risk. Maintain WATCH bias, adding on pullbacks to support rather than chasing +20% moves.

Expect continued outperformance in ID-driven climate plays as policy support and electrification accelerate, while US names benefit from grid modernization and data-center load.

Maintain neutral aggregate; US weakness is transient, ID strength is structural.
